summary: Saved dashboard query times out for >24h ranges and associated tracing links return 404
description:
Issue summary: Saved dashboard query for 'usage_per_model' consistently times out when run over windows larger than 24 hours. When the query is re-run, the console shows result rows but the 'view trace' links on individual rows return a 404. Impact: Customer cannot investigate usage spikes or link traces from console; blocking incident investigation and delaying billing reconciliations for their dedicated tenant. Environment: prod (us-west), dedicated tenant soma-prod-01, console v2.8.2.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Login as customer user on SomaHealth dedicated tenant.
2) Open Console -> Dashboards -> Saved Queries -> 'usage_per_model'.
3) Set time range to last 7 days and Run.
4) Observe spinner; query returns after ~60s with partial results.
5) Click 'View Trace' on any row -> 404 from tracing endpoint.

Expected behavior: Query completes within SLO (<30s) for 7d with aggregated rollups; 'View Trace' opens full trace in tracing UI. Actual behavior: Long-running query (~60-90s) or times out depending on occasional backend throttling; trace links point to tracing URL with missing trace id or return 404. Logs/IDs: Request id 9c3f2ad1-console, backend query job id job-20260310-77a; trace link observed: https://console.redwood/s/traces/tx-?id=. Temporary workaround: Narrow time range to 6-12h windows or export CSV and open trace IDs from raw logs. Customer reports regression started after console release v2.8.2.

2026-03-12 16:30 - Ethan Cole (SRE): Narrowed root cause to query planner change in analytics-engine v3.4.0 leading to full-scan fallback for >24h ranges; tracing payload occasionally truncates trace_id header when the backend returns partial rows. Preparing patch.
investigation_notes: Reproduced by running saved query against long windows on staging with production snapshot. Observed query plan change from 'rollup-join' to 'full-scan' for windows >24h in analytics-engine v3.4.0. Memory pressure caused partial row responses; trace_id field omitted in partial payload -> 404 when constructing trace URL.

Associated recent deploys: analytics-engine v3.4.0 (2026-03-04), console v2.8.2 (2026-03-02). Regression likely tied to analytics-engine planner tweak. No network errors observed to the tracing service.
Relevant logs: analytics-engine OOM and GC spikes between 2026-03-10T10:30-10:45Z. Tracing service returns 404 for requests with empty trace id: status=404, path=/traces/, request_id=trace-req-77.
resolution_notes: Hotfix deployed to analytics-engine that forces use of rollup path for saved queries when time range >24h and dataset flagged as 'usage-rollup'. Patch: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1849 merged and rolled to prod us-west 2026-03-12 15:20 UTC.

Also fixed console renderer to validate trace_id before rendering link; when missing, show 'No trace available' and include raw request id for manual lookup. Console patch PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/331 deployed 2026-03-12 15:40 UTC.
Customer notified of fix and asked to verify. Recommend follow-up: add alert for analytics-engine query-plan flips and increase retention/validation on trace payloads. Postmortem scheduled.
resolution: Partial fix deployed (analytics-engine rollup enforcement + console validation). Awaiting customer confirmation. Status will move to Resolved after customer verification or 72h of stable telemetry.
